assets.name: Three-line print wordmark
assets.confidence: high for structure, medium for exact letterforms
assets.observed: Right-aligned black uppercase sans lettering; orange bars beneath each row; top bar longest, then middle, then bottom; upper-left-to-lower-right bevel at left end; bars extend slightly beyond word ends.

assets.name: Vertical letterhead mark and top band
assets.confidence: high for orientation, medium for dimensions and color
assets.observed: Three-line mark rotated -90 degrees near upper right. Thin rose-red top band. Small separate address block to its right.

assets.name: Clipped-corner enamel pin
assets.confidence: high for shape and color relationships, medium for precise dimensions
assets.observed: Orange body, black text individually surrounded by silver metal, burgundy strips with silver surrounds, silver outer perimeter. Lower-left corner removed diagonally.

assets.name: Northern U round button
assets.confidence: high for content, medium for exact serif font and color
assets.observed: Orange circle with Northern above a large U in black heavy serif.

assets.name: I SAY YES TO / NORTHERN / INTERIOR / YES / UNIVERSITY button
assets.confidence: high for content, medium for exact lettering
assets.observed: Cream round face, dark rim; serif top wording; geometric sans NORTHERN; outlined collegiate slab INTERIOR; serif YES; serif UNIVERSITY along lower arc.

assets.name: I support the INTERIOR UNIVERSITY sticker
assets.confidence: high for wording and layout, medium for exact fonts
assets.observed: Yellow horizontal rectangle, black italic serif opening line, tall condensed uppercase sans main line, black underline.

assets.name: CALL TOLL FREE contact sticker
assets.confidence: high for text and structure, medium for colors and typography
assets.observed: Cream border/background, gray frame and left block, white serif CALL/TOLL/FREE stacked left, blue sans INTERIOR/UNIVERSITY SOCIETY upper right, blue bold serif 1-800-663-3219 below. Number is historical reference, not verified current.

assets.name: SUPPORT CAMPAIGN secondary type unit
assets.confidence: high for wording and position, medium for exact font
assets.observed: Two black uppercase sans rows, SUPPORT larger than CAMPAIGN, lower-right of brochure.

assets.name: Graduate group illustration
assets.confidence: medium for composition, limited for small facial detail
assets.observed: Ten overlapping graduates arranged roughly 2/3/3/2 in depth. Black linework and filled mortarboards. A new hand-constructed vector interpretation must be identified as interpretive, not recovered original artwork.

assets.name: Brochure cover application
assets.confidence: high for arrangement, low for physical page dimensions
assets.observed: Narrow portrait cream cover, IUS mark upper right, graduates central, SUPPORT CAMPAIGN lower right.

assets.name: Membership/supporter form application
assets.confidence: high for heading/grid structure, variable for small text
assets.observed: Yellow stock, uppercase society heading, statement of support, boxed character-entry rows, membership/supporter choice boxes, date/signature areas. Small text should be marked untranscribed if not readable.

assets.name: Supporter petition spread
assets.observed: Left heading YOUR PERSONAL, $5 SUPPORTER PETITION IS VITAL! and body copy; right registration form. Full lower body affected by reflection/occlusion.

assets.name: Business fundraising letter application
assets.confidence: high for prominent text, variable for body
assets.observed: Vertical IUS logo, centered serif headline A UNIVERSITY FOR / PRINCE GEORGE / NOT KELOWNA; WE NEED A UNIVERSITY. Historic contact details not current.

assets.name: Collegiate sweatshirt lettering
assets.observed: INTERIOR arched above partly hidden UNIVERSITY. Folds and photo resolution prevent an exact reconstruction.
